structural_packets.sub_item: Garbage-collect service-root ambiguity by publishing closed-world inventory roots before structural migration.
structural_packets.max_scope: direct-child root classification seed; no nested crate migration in this packet
structural_packets.rollback_inverse: Remove seed inventory entries added by this packet and re-run //:service-root-classifier-check to verify RED before reverting.
structural_packets.trunk_checkpoint: dev head plus trusted oya-ci-required after live producer cutover; not satisfied by this local/static packet
